2608.19802.title: Stopping and Routing LLM Judge Panels
2608.19802.paper_summary: LLM evaluation pipelines often have many candidate judges: general LLM-as-a-judge prompts, reward models, safety classifiers, confidence variants, and task-specific verifiers. The deployment question is not only which judge is best, but which judges should be called, on which examples, and when panel construction should stop. We formulate judge-panel design as a role-conditioned allocation problem. From a small labeled audit set, declared slices, and judge costs, the method estimates target-relative roles: copies add no conditional information, complements improve the global panel, and specialists help only on slices. These roles induce a policy: drop copies, add complements globally, route specialists conditionally, and stop when validation gain falls below a threshold. Across reasoning, code, safety, preference, reward-model, summarization, and math audits, the method is compared with single judges, flat panels, matched diversity heuristics, full-call stacking, reliability juries, and frugal cascades. The result is a regime map for judge calls: route specialists on deployable slices, stop in saturated verifier regimes, keep broad ensembles when their risk benefit is worth the cost, and ignore conditional copies. The output is a reusable, auditable call plan for the next evaluation batch.
2608.19802.paper_summary_zh: LLM 評估流程通常有許多候選評審：一般的 LLM 作為評審提示、獎勵模型、安全分類器、信心變體和特定任務的驗證器。部署問題不僅是哪個評審最好，而是應該呼叫哪些評審、在什麼範例上以及何時應停止小組構建。我們將評審小組設計形式化為一個角色條件分配問題。從一小部分標記的審核集、已聲明的切片和評審成本中，該方法估計目標相關角色：複製不增加任何條件信息，補充改善全球小組，專家僅在切片上提供幫助。這些角色引發了一種政策：丟棄複製，全球添加補充，條件性地路由專家，當驗證增益低於閾值時停止。在推理、代碼、安全、偏好、獎勵模型、總結和數學審核中，該方法與單一評審、平面小組、匹配多樣性啟發式、全調用堆疊、可靠性陪審團和節儉級聯進行比較。結果是一個評審呼叫的制度地圖：在可部署的切片上路由專家，在飽和驗證者制度中停止，當其風險收益值得成本時保持廣泛的合奏，並忽略條件複製。輸出是一個可重用的、可審核的呼叫計劃，用於下一批評估。
